test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

Sourabh said, “Alas! We have been cheated.”

options.text: Sourabh exclaimed with sorrow that they have been cheated.
Sourabh said that oh we have cheated.
Sourabh exclaimed with sorrow that they had been cheated.
Sourabh was sad that they were cheated.

solution:
The correct answer is: "**Sourabh exclaimed with sorrow that they had been cheated.**"
